moments.explanation: Bag it, boat it, dump it where nobody looks. Straight out of Dexter's opening repertoire, and it works every time nobody has been tailing him for weeks.

evidence.note: Dexter carries the bags down the dock to the boat.

moments.explanation: Everyone told Doakes to drop it. He followed his gut all the way to the Everglades, the only move that catches Dexter in the act.

evidence.note: Doakes steps out of the reeds with his gun drawn.

moments.explanation: He has the gun, the evidence and the angle. Every second spent enjoying it is a second Dexter spends thinking, and thinking is Dexter's best weapon.
moments.bestMove: Cuff him from a distance and call it in before saying a word.

evidence.note: Long close-up of Doakes grinning down the barrel.

moments.explanation: Panic gets you shot. Dexter stays calm, keeps his hands where Doakes can see them and gives a nervous man nothing to react to.
moments.bestMove: Keep him talking and steer him toward the cuffs.

evidence.note: Dexter stands still by the boat.

moments.explanation: Kneeling, slow, compliant. Looking defeated lowers Doakes' guard, and every step of the surrender brings Dexter a step closer to the gun.
Rule one with an armed suspect: keep your distance. Doakes lets a serial killer close enough to grab the gun.
moments.bestMove: Order him to stop ten feet out and kneel.

evidence.note: Dexter steps forward holding the cuffs.
